{{Lunisolar September}} 
'''September 1''' is the 1st day of month {{ill|September (Lunisolar)|ja|9月 (旧暦)|lt=September (Nagatsuki)}}  the 9th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rokuyō}}  day is {{ill|senpu|ja|先負|qid=Q96759842}}{{efn|ja|先負|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q9418169}}{{efn|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Senbu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 六曜|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q9418169}} .
